description_text:
Based on the geometry of the iconic Aalto vase of 1937 this serie reimplements a functional object as stand alone design piece. This design balances on the edge in-between functionality, digital aesthetics, mass customisation and object oriented eclecticism. In contrast to contemporary thought and design, which views things as the aggregation or assembly of smaller bits and parts, in Object Oriented Design new objects emerge out of an ecology of interaction of multiple and heterogeneous objects. Through a process of formation or computation, highly differentiated, contradictory concepts and structures can become one object, without resulting in an incongruous collage.
The use of contemporary production techniques as 3d printing offers this design a substantial relevance, since it is designed throughout a series of semi automated steps. This would enable the creation of several variations of this classical design piece, with the advantage of being able to print out customised vases on demand. All slightly different in erosion type or crystalline formations. Always following the same design rules, production time and all for approximately the same price. Economically this makes a lot of sense since their would not be any overstock needed like in other production methods, where prices only go down depending on a large amount of produced items.

description_text:
An early cosmological model of our solar system, in full 3d-printed detail. From Kepler's book _Mysterium Cosmographicum_, 1596. Kepler thought that the planets orbited the Earth, each within an orbit set on a regular polyhedron. He was mightily wrong, but his design is iconic and inspiring.  
All regular polyhedra are represented, in this order from the inside out: octahedron, icosahedron, dodecahedron, tetrahedron, cube. I also included the text from the page of Kepler's book, Tabvla III Orbivm Planetarvm and Johannes Kepler on the opposite side of the base.  
Try coloring it! The material is porous and you can submerge it into tea, wine, etc to give it color.  
Notes on Kepler's work and this planetary model:  
_In the XVI century, the German astronomer Johannes Kepler (1571-1630) tried to find a relation among the five regular platonic solids and the six planets known in his time: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn. Kepler thought the two numbers were connected: the reason there were only six planets was because there were only five regular solids.  
In 1596, in his work Mysterium Cosmographicum, Kepler established a model of the solar system where the five platonic solids were inserted one inside another, separated by a series of inscribed spheres. He realized that the ratios among the planets orbits' radii could match the ratios among the spheres' radii. His model, however, was not supported by the experimental data from the astronomers Tycho Brahe (Danish, 1546-1601) and Nicolau Copernicus (Polish, 1473-1543). Indeed, his model was entirely disapproved by posterior discoveries of the planets Uranus and Neptune: there are no additional platonic solids that determine their distances to the Sun. However, from his research, new solids were discovered (that, nowadays, are named after him), the perception that the orbits of the planets are not circles but ellipses, and the three laws of the planetary motion._

description_text:
•         Let me present to you high-quality middle-poly 3D model of vacuum cleaner Dyson DC37. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real vacuum cleaner that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•        The model uses 18 simple colored materials and 6 materials with 4 textures used in various combination and 2 of them is used as mask for sign, logos etc.• The model is Rigged and has Character set with 6 poses. This Rig Setup mainly expects to set any static pose for interior or object visualization, but simple animation you can create too. If you need to create difficult animation with dynamic on hose you can create your own Rig with any NOT_RIGGED_POSES scenes which include no deformed hose mesh, or set Default_hose_Pose in Character Poses.
• To control model with Rig Setup select only control curves. These curves include all necessary channels to control the Character model. Blend Parent attribute needs to detach some model parts for individual positioning like head, container, filter, pipe. Geometry, Control Curves, and Clusters are in relevant Display Layers. If you need to hide the relevant part group of the model (head, pipe, etc.) use the Visibility attribute on Control Curves.
• NOT_RIGGED_POSES scenes not have Rig Setup and include simple models in basic poses for use in other 3D programs. All scenes format except .mb and .ma have no Rigging Setup.
•        The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
•        The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
•        Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
•        To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Middle-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
These Destroyers are very detailed and built near to scale for an accurate representation of the original object. It looks very realistic and renders nicely without any special render software. It includes a lot of detail on weather decks. Many features are animateable including rudders, propellers, radar antennas, guns, missile launchers, missiles, hanger doors, and others. The model comes with high resolution textures that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2013. Note that every ship in a particular class has variations from the original design criteria and these variations are not always available to us. These models come in a wide variety of formats.
The Spruance Destroyer Class was designed to escort a Carrier Task force and protect it from Submarine warfare.  
The first in class was commissioned in 1975 and the class served for three decades before being replaced. When they began to age they were decommissioned and not upgraded in favor of the newer Arleigh Burke Class Destroyers. The last Spruance was decommissioned in 2005.

description_text:

3DRnB Scene 02- Modern Kitchen Interior for Cinema 4D and VrayforC4D
Our target is always to give the best quality without any compromise in the creation of our assets. Therefore we have physically accurate shaders, high resolution textures, very detailed geometries, cameras and lights with physically correct values, and scenes and render settings that will guarantee the best balance between the final quality and speed of use.
We like to think that we are offering much more than a simple collection of assets like the many you can already find online, by studying these scenes you will have a chance to understand how to set your own workflow in order to obtain consistent results.
In these scenes, you will find many render settings. From the very fast one for previews, to the production ones that will give you the best balance speed/quality, to those high quality ones if you like results without any noise and don’t mind the time it takes to calculate it.
Every scene will always have a PS post production file where you can observe how to modify the render in a fast and non-destructive way, an amazingly detailed pdf guide that will explain how we worked, which softwares and plugins we used and reasons behind certain decisions.
What’s included:
-Cinema 4D file (3D model, Vray cameras, lights and 56 shaders 100% DR ready)  -All the objects you see are part of the 3d scene -High resolution textures  -Post Production files (Photoshop CC required for best use)  -Final images saved in jpeg format (Any photoshop can be used)  -PDF Guide with tips and techniques regarding modeling, lighting, rendering and post-production (English and Italian language )
Requirements:  The 3D Scene has been tested with C4D R.14, 15,16,17 on both Mac and PC  Minimum requirements for optimal results is VrayforC4D 1.9.0.b (compatible with VrayforC4D 3.4 when available)  Photoshop CC is recommended  Hardware requirements: 8Gb RAM, 16Gb strongly recommend

description_text:
Sopwith is built near to scale for an accurate representation of the original object. It includes very detailed exterior, highly detailed rotary engine, a very detailed cockpit and very high polygon count. This model has many animateable features such as the animated propeller and rotary engine rotate together, wheels, ailerons, elevators and rudder. The controls in the cockpit can also be animated. The instrument panel is modeled and accurate for the aircraft. It has a fully textured design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2013. The model comes in 11 different formats. Note that this model includes our Gnome 80HP Rotary engine model completely incorporated so you get the extreme detail of that model too! 
The Sopwith Camel was a British First World War single-seat biplane fighter.

description_text:
Collection of 5 3D Models with 16 Photoreal and Alternate textures of an Ancient Greek Pottery Alabastron, in its three original main shapes. With Print Stl files and Mesh reports. C4D, 3DS, OBJ, VUE6-7-8-9!____________________________________Collection of 5 3D Models with 16 Photoreal and Alternate textures.With .STL files version for 3D Printing.Each .STL file provided with its Mesh Technical Report.Also available .PLY and .123D Files.
Faithful and accurate Reconstruction of an Ancient Greek Pottery Alabastron, according to the Ancient Greece artworks and the archaeology remains and evidence.
The Greek Alabastron was mainly a vessel for oil, perfumed oil, perfume and massage oils.When without eyes or lugs by which thread could be attached, it was simply carried or kept with a thread around the neck.
In the package you will find the 3 main Greek Alabastron shapes with complete detailed original Greek pottery paintings MAPS:1-Corinthian Alabastron [A1-A2] with and without eye [8 to 10 cm h]2-Greek-Etruscan Alabastron [A3] handleless [10 to 20 cm h]3-Athenian Alabastron [A4-A5] with and without eyes [10 to 20 cm h]
In the package you will find:1- Corinthian Alabastron [A1-A2] with and without eye [9.7 cm h C4D]; [1]2- Greek-Etruscan Alabastron [A3] handleless [17 cm h C4D]; [2]3- Athenian Alabastron [A4-A5] with and without eyes [17.1 cm h C4D]; [3]4- .OBJ FULL closed version; [4]5- .STL version for 3D Printing with Mesh Technical Report for each file; [5]6- .PLY version; [6]7- 16 Hi-Quality Hi-Def PhotoReal Textures [2048x1024; 2048x1017; 512x512; etc.]; [7]8- Alternate Pottery Surface Textures with colour variations to create different types of Greek Pottery; [8]9- 3 original Ancient Greek Pottery UV MAPS to customize and weathering for the models. [9]
All the Models are prepared Hi-DEF and Photoreal, perfect for any type of Rendering!
Models Polygons and Vertices [VUE and 3DS] for C4D, OBJ Polygons are [ca /2]:
Corinthian Alabastron A1 [26160; 14185]Corinthian Alabastron A2 with eye [27094; 14828]Greek-Etruscan Alabastron A3 [23834; 12960]Athenian Alabastron A4 [36000; 19670]Athenian Alabastron A5 with eyes [36980; 20388]
[Data are from VUE report system on VUE files only]
Enjoy THE ARCHAEO.SYS 3D SERIES.
The Archaeo.Sys 3D series is developing high-fidelity 3D reconstruction of Objects, Architecture and Scenes from Classical Greek and Roman Antiquity.

For this kind of price I expected a lot more ...

First of all the positives:
The modeling quality is very good. The topology is great and it has lots of detail. From a distance it looks like this model would be great for close-up renders that need a lot of detail.

And then come the negative parts:
I haven't tried this in 3ds Max so maybe everything is fine there, but when I imported this into Blender the scale was completely off. Also everything was connected into one mesh, so there was no grouping or labeling as the owner said and no separate pivots. Okay, not a big deal — those things can be fixed relatively easily. Then I tried importing the original textures and I realized that it doesn’t have baked PBR maps, just one tileable wood texture (diffuse + roughness) and then a couple of image textures for details. That means if you want different materials (like the gold parts), you have to manually select those vertices, assign them the materials, and repeat that for every separate material.

And it gets better, because the entire model isn’t even correctly UV mapped. So if you want to use PBR materials for other parts of the model (like the gold and silver parts for better realism), then you have to do all of that yourself. I assume the owner used basic metallic shaders for their renders, so UVs weren’t a problem there. Just something to look out for if you need more control and need this to be photorealistic. Out of the blue, this model definitely isn’t ready for photorealistic close-up renders and it still requires a lot of cleanup and retouching.

Maybe I misunderstood, but it seemed like this model should be ready for photorealistic renders and even close-ups. As of now I am very disappointed with the quality (especially the materials, or lack thereof) this offered. It certainly isn’t worth that high price tag. description_text:
- General
This is a 3d model of a wooden tray, specifically AHLENS Bricka Carved. It was scanned and prepared for photorealistic renderings, close-ups, stills and animation. The wooden tray model is ready to be inserted in your scene out of the box.
  - Meshes
The wooden walnut tray model is presented as single mesh. Mesh is quad based. Model polycount is 3074. For closeups a subdivision modifier is recommended. High detail model included in .max, .fbx, .stl and .obj formats. High detail model has 786k quads.
  - Materials
.max 2017 files come with corona 6 and vray 4.3 materials. Other versions have basic materials, so you will need to adjust them in connection with your particular software.
  - Textures
5 maps are supplied with this model. 8192x8192 PNGs and downsampled versions in 2048x2048 JPGs. The maps include ao, diffuse, glossiness, normal and displacement(tif). A 16K diffuse texture map is also included. The wooden plate model is uvw unwrapped.
  - Formats
The original file was created in 3ds Max 2017 with Corona and Vray materials (6 and 4.3). You will receive a 3DS, OBJ, LWO, FBX, SKP, C4D, 3DM, STL and MAX file(2017). If you need any other format please enquire via CGTrader.
  - Information
All preview images were rendered with Corona. You will get only the wooden tray and not the scenes used for the preview renders. Please also take into consideration that the preview images are the result of the post-production and the look of black walnut tray 3d model in your scene may differ due to the specific settings of your own scene. Product is ready to render out-of-the-box. Please note that the lights, cameras, and any background not described above objects are not included in the product. The model is clean and alone in the provided files, centred at origin and has real-world scale.

description_text:
A 10 x 2.5 meter of cloth embellishment cover for walls or room partitioning. Fully unwrapped surface, any custom pattern can be applied in the material hierarchy.
Model has a backside with backside material, without a backside the face count is 44193.
Model is medium poly count with AO, specular and normal maps, adapted for quality realtime, but will work in renderings, just activate subdivision.
The material hierarchy allows great customisation possibilites.
Model uses standard Max materials and was rendered in Scanline mode with one Shadow light.
 OBJ and 3DS versions are simple mesh exports, FBX version has basic materials.
Unity v3.5PRO version provided with custom shaders. See realtime demo.
Concept and design by the artist.

Astoria Storm
Thanks to Storm, baristas are free to express themselves and explore their capacity for experimentation through simple and comfortable actions. Storm is research on values ​​that have been lost over time but re-emerged thanks to a new cultural and artisanal approach, which spread rapidly in the world. The coffee dispensed is at the center of every care. Baristas’ gestures the protagonists on stage and have a highly symbolic value. The relationship between those who operate the machine and who savor coffee is revolutionized: the barista who has chosen coffee beans, roasting and brewing with an almost maniacal dedication can offer ritual preparation and storytelling.This is Storm the traditional coffee machine from Astoria, I made it almost globally with editable poly, I leave it in Low poly with the modifier Turbosmooth in Render Iters for a better maneuverability in a big scene, I try to name the models and groups and the materials. Highly detailed and photo realistic model of the Oscar Award
======================================================

Handed out during the most watched awards ceremony in the world, the Academy Award/Oscar Statue depicts a knight rendered in art deco style holding a crusader's sword standing on a reel of film with five spokes. Source: Wikipedia

Created in Maya 2012 and rendered with V-Ray. Maya scene file includes lighting setup and is ready to render. All file formats contain identical geometry and layout as seen above with clean and accurate construction.

Close attention to detail makes this model ideal for close ups and print work. Each file format has been checked with the appropriate software.

description_text:
Villa Bella - Art gallery

This white-plastered cubic building at the Cote d-Azur, a landmark between palmtrees and rock-formations, has served for many years as an exhibition space for art-galleries of fame.

The Black & White theme of the house can also be found in the details. The black steel ladder functions as a unique piece of decoration en maybe even as a natural harness for the fragile handmade vase. Next to it is the floorlamp Cubik 180, designed by Jean-Mari Massaud (2005).

The long white sofa Andy, a design by Paolo Piva (2002), placed in line with the hanging balcony, accentuates the horizontal interaction of lines, to be found throughout the building.

The side-table is a design by Antonio Cittero (2003) from the Simplice-collection of Maxalto.

The chairs, from the SOLO-series by Antonio Citterio, placed around The Table by designer Monica Armani (2006) form the central meetingpoint in the house.

Specifactions:
Original MAX 2009-file (Mental Ray)
Mental Ray materials (Mostly procedural mappings)
Textures paintings etc. included
Daylight system MR + SkyPortal
Preview images contain Post-Effects; Photoshop (example-file included), AO-pass (max2009-file included (Mental Ray))
Also available as; .obj (exported, incl .mtl) .3ds (exported)

MAX specific; Where possible Modifier-stack intact.

description_text: In AD 132, Zhang Heng of China's Han dynasty invented the first seismoscope by the definition above, which was called Houfeng Didong Yi literally, instrument for measuring the seasonal winds and the movements of the Earth. The description we have, from the History of the Later Han Dynasty, says that it was a large bronze vessel, about 2 meters in diameter; at eight points around the top were dragon's heads holding bronze balls. When there was an earthquake, one of the mouths would open and drop its ball into a bronze toad at the base, making a sound and supposedly showing the direction of the earthquake. On at least one occasion, probably at the time of a large earthquake in Gansu in AD 143, the seismoscope indicated an earthquake even though one was not felt. The available text says that inside the vessel was a central column that could move along eight tracks; this is thought to refer to a pendulum, though it is not known exactly how this was linked to a mechanism that would open only one dragon's mouth. The first ever earthquake recorded by this seismograph was supposedly somewhere in the east. Days later, a rider from the east reported this earthquake.

TipologiaBollitore in acciaio inoxDesignerMichael Graves9091 - Bollitore in acciaio inossidabile 18/10 lucido con fischietto melodico in ottone e manico in PA, nero.‎ Fondo in acciaio magnetico.‎Realizzato in acciaio inox 18/10, il bollitore 9091 ha un fischietto melodico in ottone dalla forma inedita.‎ Richard Sapper l'ha creato ispirandosi a un ricordo d'infanzia, il poetico suono delle sirene dei battelli sul fiume Reno: perché la melodia che accompagna l'uscita del vapore dev'essere gradevole, non ansiogena come il fischio tipico dei bollitori.‎Disegnato da Richard Sapper il bollitore 9091 in acciaio inox 18/10 è stato il primo dei bollitori d'autore Alessi.‎ Per evitare il solito rumore ansiogeno prodotto dai bollitori, Sapper ha dotato il 9091 di un fischietto melodico, realizzato in ottone e costituito da due piccole canne in cui sono inseriti dei coristi che riproducono le note mi e si.‎Nel momento in cui esce il vapore, i due coristi generano un’amabile breve melodia.‎ Il bollitore 9091 è un oggetto polisensoriale, che non interromperà una pausa di piacere con un fischio, ma con un'avvolgente melodia.‎

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model LG 32LH519U. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real TV that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of one mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. description_text:
Detailed model of a wooden wall clock. It’s classic style is ideal for many type of interior scenes.
The models are properly UV mapped and textured (diffuse, normal and specularity). Ready for quality renders and close ups. Renders were created with Cycles with 1 level of subdivision applied.
Tech info:All objects are subdivision surfaces but it look great even without subdivision.Object origin is set to the center of the back of the base model for easy placement and scaling. All the other objects are parented to the Wallclock_base object.Materials are set for Cycles. Textures are in 4K and 2K resolution.
The model is made of 15 objects, with meaningful names. The clock hands and the door have rotation constraints to limit their movement.
Total Polygon count w/o subdiv: 21900Total Vertex count w/o subdiv: 22400
Total Polygon count with subdiv: 72100Total Vertex count with subdiv: 73100
Package info:There are 2 different blend files included:WallClock_model_only.blend – only contains the models with the materials.WallClock_cycles_final.blend – contains the models and all the lightning settings and cameras that were used for the preview images. The models are on layer 1.
OBJ and FBX files are tested in 3ds Max
To use only the models you can choose append from your scene and navigate to the WallClock_model_only.blend file and append the models by their group (WallClock) or simply open the blend file and you will find the models at the center on layer 1. Scale and rotations are applied to avoid issues during editing.

description_text:
A highly realistic 3D model of a common dust mite, created with a strong focus on anatomical accuracy and surface detail. The model is supplied at three polygon densities, making it suitable for close-up rendering, scientific visualization, or educational use.
The mesh was sculpted in ZBrush, with a custom hand-drawn comb displacement texture on the dorsal surface, created using a Wacom tablet to achieve crisp micro-detail and controlled bump definition. Geometry and surface flow are clean throughout, with carefully prepared UV unwrapping for reliable texturing and rendering.
3D print High resolustion STLs included.
The model is static and not rigged for animation. Cotton threads shown in reference images are not included in this upload and will be provided as a separate model.
Polygon counts
Medium: 45,568 polygons
High: 182,274 polygons
Extremely High: 2,916,352 polygons
Clean topology and production-ready UVs are included.

description_text:
3D model of the Pyrotherapy and isolation steambath/sauna. The heater to heat the water for the steambath function is placed underneath the cabins. A flue runs trough the water box and directs the smoke to the space below the cabins, trapping the heat and thus increasing the thermal efficiency. The smoke can escape trough small gaps between the soil and the wooden skirt below the cabins. The water box is made up of 5 sections and can be rearranged to become smaller. the flue is also decomposable and can be made smaller. This modular approach allows to make a system for less than 5 cabins (ie 3 or 1 cabin). 4 (red) boxes between the grey boxes direct the steam towards the cabins. When the sauna option is preferred (and not the steambath option), this box can be closed with a lid. This way, no steam will rise into the cabin, yet the box will still give off significant heat, allowing dry heat to be created with in the cabin.

The main purpose of the Pyrotherapy and isolation steambath/sauna is to allow people to heal quicker from a disease. The heating (similar to attaining a high temperatur when you have a fever) increases the body's temperature, which is detrimental to bacteria/virusses. Also, the humid and/or dry heat can help in clearing the airways. See the 'Purchasing_the_models' link at appropedia's AT_CAD_Team for additional information on the model

description_text: 3D model of the AT dishwasher. The AT dishwasher is a low-cost dishwasher without doors or hinges. Instead, a plastic panel can be removed from the front using clamps. Once this is done, the baskets can be hung slided inside it. A special piping system allows to reuse greywater (slightly dirty (allready used) water with soap)) several times to wash the dishes/crockery. Used water with soap is collected from the bottom of the bishwasher and recirculated. After reusing the water a number of times it is refed with new (clean) water. All of this is done using valves, controlled automatically by a printed circuit board (PCB). The green part on the piping represents the pump. Natural cleaning agent is done in the soap box for mixing with the water. At the bottom on the 3 plastic panels is a heater coil that allows air to be heated (for the drying, after the washing). A valve is present on the top plastic panel for releasing the moist air to the atmosphere. Both are controlled by the PCB. See the 'Purchasing_the_models' link at appropedia's AT_CAD_Team for additional information on the model

Bar Tools Roll-Up
Bar Tools Roll-Up Set includes 33 objects what can be used in scenes with following subjects: bar, pub, party, club, kitchen, interior design, ...
Scene contains 42 objects, backfaces of some objects are deleted, Stitches realized as a mesh not texture.
3D Models made in 2016 max, saved as 2013, max scene file + 3DS,OBJ,FBX,Blender2.92, Rendered in Corona 2.0
Quads & Triangles, and Real-world scale/proportions, all objects was made according to references.
Models have simple materials maps componence (2k/4k) + material library file for Corona2/ Vray5/ Blender.
Pivot point in center or bottom of objects.

Polys: 595008Verts: 637374

description_text:
- Classic manual grinder model, very popular in the mid-twentieth century.

  - With moving parts on separate meshes for easy animation. 

  - Model designed for close-up.

  - With original hand-painted textures.

  - Rig and animation included.

  - Also available without rig.

  - Units of file: centimeters.

  - Size in centimeters: 45 (X axis), 35.5 (Y axis), 40.5 (Z axis).

  - Real world scale. (1,1,1).

  - Focused on the origin.

TOPOLOGY

  - An object with 6 meshes manifold.

  - 100% quads (7,206 quads).

  - 7,208 vertex and 14,412 edges.

  - Subdividable topology.

  - Clean edge flow.

  - No isolated vertices.

  - No coincident vertices.

  - No coincident/coplanar faces.

  - No faces intersected. 

  - No faces distorted more than 45 degrees.

  - No loss geometry.

  - No poles with more than 5 edges.

RIG

  - Armature with 6 animable bones.

  - With intuitive shapes to replace bones.

  - The shape and color of the shapes indicates the action that can make the bone (move, rotate or scale) and the axis he does.

  - Auxiliary objects for shapes are hidden in another layer.

  - The actions and its range of allowable values are controlled by constraint on each bone.

  - Instructions for use of the rig.

  - With rig and animation included.

UVMAP AND TEXTURES 

  - Normal outward.

  - UV without overlapping.

  - Grinder textures of 4096x4096 px.

  - Tablecloth texture of 2048x2048 px.

Image textures included:

  - grinder_diffuse.png

  - grinder_specular.png

  - grinder_bump.png

  - grinder_normal.png (OPTIONAL)

  - tablecloth_diffuse.png

PREVIEWS

  - The images of the mesh in orthographic view.

  - Renders with the Blender internal engine. All without post production. 

The FBX file is exported from Blender 2.78 (-Z Forward, Y Up) and may need some adjustment (textures, shapes).

Hi I am Frezzy from Vnvisual studio.
This model is high quality, photo real model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects.The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.Fidelity is optimal up to a 4k render. Renders have no postprocessing.
This model is ready to be animated. You can easily position it the way you need or animate.
+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All colors can be easily modified.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 V-Ray ( 2.4 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2012 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2012 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2012 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2012 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R12 with standard materials

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures )
  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).
+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

+++++++++++++++About Vnvisual:We are a team of 3D artists with over a decade of experience in the field. My team participated in various projects allowing us to learn our clients needs.Every model we build goes through thorough quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality, which you can tell by looking at the renders none of the has any postprocessing.On the top of that all the models come with complete UVs and optimized topology, which allows you in no time alter geo or the textures if needed.

description_text:
Think of the scent that hovers in your nostrils right from the kitchen while you’re waiting for the food you just ordered. Think of the moment when the waiter walks right towards your table with the food in his hand. Think about how comfortable it feels to eat outside. While we can't reproduce the feeling of eating out, this Japanese industrial kitchen inspired restaurant pack for sure has almost everything you need to build a realistic kitchen for your games and visualizations!
Contains 58 assets to create realistic kitchen environments! Included assets are such as food containers, shelves, gas stoves, sink, bowls, pots, fry pans, ducts and much more.
All the materials are made using PBR workflow, which results in high-quality assets in any situation. Models utilize weighed normals workflow, which means the models are high quality without large normal maps or extra vertices. Assets are usable in various situations ranging from VR to games and mobile to visualizations
Assets are in a real-world scale and have created with dimensions to mirror real-world schools as accurately as possible. All the assets have PBR textures. Textures come in a packed form, reducing the file size when distributing your game or visualization.
Models include the following textures:

  - Albedo

  - Normal Map

  - Packed PBR (Roughness, Metalness, Ambient Occlusion)

The packaged PBR texture has the following textures assigned on RGB channels:

  - Red = Ambient Occlusion

  - Green = Roughness

  - Blue = Metalness

If you have any questions regarding the 3D models, please do not hesitate to send me a message :)
Note: scene not included, rendered in Unreal Engine

description_text:
Workshop Props & Pipes is a collection of realistic props for quickly decorating environments and supplying characters with equipment for the Unity Engine.
MeshesWith the goal being to accommodate as many use cases as possible, we've included sensible assets with parent-based rigs for easy posing. However, if you're not needing assets that customizable, we've also included meshes that are pre-posed and combined as a single mesh for optimization.
TexturesTextures are provided in TGA format at a resolution of 2048px by 2048px. Some asset's are atlased together for a compromise on texture detail and performance efficiency. You may also notice that some textures will not utilize all of their UV space. For those, we're thinking of using that space for new future assets we'll be releasing down the line. For some of our textures, we're providing PSDs for recoloring aspects of albedo maps. In the future, we'd like to extend this customization to lots of other painted assets.
CollidersFor the most part we have primarily used primitives for the colliders in all prefabs. However, there are a few cases here & there that we are using a convex mesh colliders. We've named both types differently if users want to disable the mesh colliders in their projects. Primitives are named ColObject while mesh colliders are named ColObject_Mesh.
Hierarchy, Colliders, & Mesh RenderersFor the prefabs in this package we have split our colliders & visual into two child game objects, _Visuals & _Colliders. We realize that not everyone will need to have colliders for their projects or need complex colliders for rigid body purposes. Users can quickly drag all the prefabs into a new empty scene, search for _Colliders, disable the game objects, and apply the changes to the prefabs to get you into level design as fast as possible!
V1.0 Assets include:

description_text:
Hello, I am Frezzy.
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.Fidelity is optimal up to a 4K render. Renders have no postprocessing.--INFO ABOUT 3D MODELS:Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All colors can be easily modified.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 V-Ray ( 2.4 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ (Multi Format)

  - 3DS (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2012

  - Cinema 4D R12

  - FBX (Multi Format)All Files was archived with winrar 5.4. If you get error when extract, please use the latest version fo winrar. ( winrar is free for all )

Textures: ( just for the models have textures )

  - High resolution ( ready for 4K rendering ) and named, easy to find and editing.

  - Photoshop File ( Photoshop CC2017 was included for editing textures like you want )

Also check out my other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

Real world scale (centimeters).
Rigged with constrains, bones, skin and Spline IK Control.
Unwraped UVs, 2 texture sets:

  - Set 1: 4096*4096

  - Set 2: 2048*2048

Contains Vray and PBR (Metal/Roughness and Specular/Glossiness) maps:

  - Vray: Diffuse, Reflection, Glossiness, Normal, Fresnel IOR

  - PBR spec/gloss: Diffuse, Specular, Glossiness, Normal

  - PBR metal/rough: Diffuse, Metalness, Roughness, Normal

Scene and render setup is not included.
.max file contains rigged model with Vray materials applied
.fbx files are geometry with vray materials applied
.obj files are with geometry only

description_text:
A wheelchair is a chair with wheels, designed to be a replacement for walking. The device comes in variations where it is propelled by motors or by the seated occupant turning the rear wheels by hand. Often there are handles behind the seat for someone else to do the pushing. Wheelchairs are used by people for whom walking is difficult or impossible due to illness (physiological or physical), injury, or disability. People with both sitting and walking disability often need to use a wheelbench.

The earliest records of wheeled furniture was an inscription found on a stone slate in China and a child’s bed depicted in a frieze on a Greek vase, both dating back to the 6th century B.C. Later dates relate to Europeans using this technology during the German Renaissance.
Harry Jennings and his disabled friend Herbert Everest, both mechanical engineers, invented the first lightweight, steel, collapsible wheelchair in 1933. Everest had broken his back in a mining accident.

- Approx 42,479 polygons.
- The wheels are separate groups, which your software should read as separate parts.

description_text:
Creme Jar v003 3D model
Facial creme jar with creme.This jar is modeled after a Estee Lauder (nutritious vitality8)
This creme jar is made for high quality product shots, and is set up to be as flexible as possible. This product can be used in professional productions. When you purchase this model you'll get and FBX file with the lid, the inner lid, the jar, the inner jar and the creme with a blendshape. Included are also OBJ versions of the lid, the inner lid, the jar, the inner jar, the pointy creme and the flat creme.

description_text:
Creme Jar v002 3D model
Facial creme jar with creme.This jar is modeled after a Lancome creme jar (genifique nutrics)
This creme jar is made for high quality product shots, and is set up to be as flexible as possible. This product can be used in professional productions. The polygon count is sufficient to get clean and smooth renders, even at extreme close-ups. The model consists of a jar, the creme, the lid, the inner lid and the lid cap, all are seperate objects to be able to set up the shot as you want. The thread is fully moddeled in both the jar and the inner lid. The creme has a blendshape between pointy and completely flat. All objects have full unwrapped UV's with as little distortion as possible, so it's very easy to texture.
When you purchase this model you'll get and FBX file with the lid, the inner lid, the lid cap, the jar and the creme with a blendshape. Included are also OBJ versions of the lid, the inner lid, the lid cap, the jar, the pointy creme and the flat creme.

After the Meiji Restoration in 1868, the samurai were banned from carrying swords as part of an attempt to modernize Japan. Though a demand for military swords remained and some sword-smiths still produced traditional samurai swords as art, the majority of sword-smiths refocused their skill to cutlery production, following the cultural shift. The production of steel knives in Sakai began in the 16th century, when tobacco was introduced to Japan by the Portuguese and Sakai craftsmen started to make knives for cutting tobacco. The Sakai knife industry received a major boost from the Tokugawa shogunate (1603–1868), which granted Sakai a special seal of approval and enhanced its reputation for quality. Today, Seki, Gifu is considered the home of modern Japanese kitchen cutlery, where state-of-the-art manufacturing technology has updated ancient forging skills to produce a world-class series of stainless and laminated steel kitchen knives.

description_text:
Two opposing yet identical Senegalese sweetgrass baskets make up the perfectly balanced the Stephen Burks Man Made Double Basket Lamp. This double pendant glows with daylight bulbs diffused by two discs of textured polycarbonate and is suspended from the center by two intertwined black and white cords. Prototyped and developed as part of the Studio Museum exhibition, Stephen Burks Man Made, 2011.
This model is Stephen Burks Man Made studio approved and is a precise replica of the real item.
Polygon model of Double Basket Lamp of Stephen Burks Man Made Senegalese Collection. Ready for close-up rendering, uses V-Ray materials.

description_text:
- Portable extinguisher rigged low-poly. 

  - Suitable for close-up, VR, real_time, games, and ready for animation. 

  - Quality mesh and original hand painted textures with 2 versions of labels. 

  - Available with/without rig.

  - File units: centimeters. 

  - Size in centimeters: 24.4 (X axis), 12.9 (Y axis), 51.54 (Z axis). 

  - Real world scale. (1,1,1). 

  - Focused on the origin.

TOPOLOGY

  - An object with three manifold meshes: extinguisher, pin and axis handle. 

  - 100% quads (5,238 quads). 

  - 5,232 vertex and 10,476 edges. 

  - Subdividable topology. 

  - Clean edge flow. 

  - No isolated vertices. 

  - No coincident vertices. 

  - No coincident/coplanar faces. 

  - No faces intersected. 

  - No faces distorted more than 45 degrees. 

  - No loss geometry. 

  - No poles with more than 5 edges. 

  - Normal outward. 

  - UV without overlapping.

UVMAP AND TEXTURES

  - Original textures hand painted of 4096x4096 px. in .png format. 

  - Two versions of the label texture: red and multicolored. 

  - Optional textures are downloaded separately in exported formats.

  - extinguisher_diffuse.png 

  - extinguisher_bump.png 

  - extinguisher_label_color_diffuse.png (OPTIONAL) 

  - extinguisher_normal.png (OPTIONAL)

PREVIEWS 

  - Renders with Bender internal engine with smooth shading. All without post production. 

  - The images of the mesh are in orthographic view.

This pack contains an old wall clock model that can be used in any realtime renderer that supports the physically based rendering pipeline aka PBR, using the metallic workflow. (If you are unsure what this means, texturing of this model is probably not compatible with your target renderer. Traditional specular/gloss maps are not included!)
The clock has separated submeshes; pendulum, minute and hour hands, so they can be animated properly.
Available formats: .OBJ, .FBX, .3DS, .DAE

This is a 5 piece collection of vintage Victorian bathroom fixtures made in Blender for the cycles renderer. There's a bathtub, toilet and sink. However, the toilet and sink come in two slightly different versions; The toilet comes with a high tank and low tank and the sink comes with two types of faucets. This vintage Victorian bathroom fixture collection is ideal for period pieces, haunted houses and horror projects or even old or abandoned house scenes that require antique elements.

description_text:

An LED lamp (LED light bulb) is a solid-state lamp that uses light-emitting diodes (LEDs) as the source of light. The LEDs involved may be conventional semiconductor light-emitting diodes, to organic LEDs (OLED), or polymer light-emitting diodes (PLED) devices, although PLED technologies are not currently commercially available.
Since the light output of individual light-emitting diodes is small compared to incandescent and compact fluorescent lamps, multiple diodes are often used together. In recent years, as diode technology has improved, high power light-emitting diodes with higher lumen output are making it possible to replace other lamps with LED lamps. One high power LED chip used in some commercial LED lights can emit 7,527 lumens while using only 100 watts. LED lamps can be made interchangeable with other types of lamps.
Diodes use direct current (DC) electrical power, so LED lamps must also include internal circuits to operate from standard AC voltage. LEDs are damaged by being run at higher temperatures, so LED lamps typically include heat management elements such as heat sinks and cooling fins. LED lamps offer long service life and high energy efficiency.

An LED lamp (LED light bulb) is a solid-state lamp that uses light-emitting diodes (LEDs) as the source of light. The LEDs involved may be conventional semiconductor light-emitting diodes, to organic LEDs (OLED), or polymer light-emitting diodes (PLED) devices, although PLED technologies are not currently commercially available.
Since the light output of individual light-emitting diodes is small compared to incandescent and compact fluorescent lamps, multiple diodes are often used together. In recent years, as diode technology has improved, high power light-emitting diodes with higher lumen output are making it possible to replace other lamps with LED lamps. One high power LED chip used in some commercial LED lights can emit 7,527 lumens while using only 100 watts. LED lamps can be made interchangeable with other types of lamps.
Diodes use direct current (DC) electrical power, so LED lamps must also include internal circuits to operate from standard AC voltage. LEDs are damaged by being run at higher temperatures, so LED lamps typically include heat management elements such as heat sinks and cooling fins. LED lamps offer long service life and high energy efficiency.

No extra plugins are required for this model. Lights and cameras are not included in the scene.

description_text:

  - The 3D model is a piece of clay art ornamented with the carving of  Hathor, the ancient Egyptian goddess of love and motherhood

  - The pot was used in ancient Egypt to store beverages or as a decoration. To make the replica, ready-made textures and internal materials have been used to give this model is current look.

  - The flask will render easily and like on thumbnails. No plugins were used to model, render, or convert the file.

  - 3D model and shaders are named properly to ensure practical navigation and inspection. 

  - If you like the model or have comments on have it could be improved, let me know in a comment!

Thank you very much!

description_text:
This is a typical household ceiling fan that can easily be put into any interior or architectural scene.  It's a SubD model, created in modo 401 with a completed 401 rig connected for controlling the fan's speed and swinging factor labelled as, OldFAN.  This adds some shake to the fan assembly as it is swinging to make it spin off balanced.
The speed can be set or keyframed or animated using the custom channels attached to the FAN control item.
To animate it in other applications, you simple need to spin the Base layer and the the blades are all children of that.  There are morph maps for swinging the strings with the shake of the fan.

description_text:
Rosendahl Models and Bodum coffee brewer. All models are very HIGH quality - there is an instanced Turbosmooth modifier on the models so they all change iterations at the same time when you are adjusting. You can ofcourse make this modifier unike to every object. The salt, pepper and the grains are generated with Tyflow. The Tyflow icon, and the Tyflow setup is included in the scene for your convenience. Tyflow is free  and relative easy to use. This means that you can generate more salt, pepper or whatever you want to fill up you objects. All textures except the flames and fingerprints (on the glass) are procedural and can easily be changed. The Brushed Metal works very well and is procedurally generated. All objects belonging together are linked to the largest object, so everything can be moved together. (do with this as you like)All pivot points on the large objects are placed 0,01 cm under the object, so they easily can be placed and aligned on top of surfaces without you having to move them up further. The scene files are for 3ds max 2019-2022 and VRay 5. - But since there are few materials you can easily convert to any render engine you want.
See polycount for low and high on the preview images - you can even go higher if you want. The only plugin used is Tyflow - but you do not need it. The scene is as you see it on the images without it, since the particles have been converted to a mesh.

This package contains a high quality, game ready retro microwave oven model that can be used in any realtime renderer that supports the physically based rendering pipeline aka PBR, using the metallic workflow. (If you are unsure what this means, texturing of this model is probably not compatible with your target renderer. Traditional specular/gloss maps are not included!)

Should you have any questions in regards with any of my products, don't hesitate to contact me here!

description_text:
Hi-res 3D model collection of grinders modelled in maya. Preview images rendered with VRay.The set contains a coffee grinder, a spice grinder and a pepper mill. 

  - high resolution 4K PBR textures (png), suitable for close up shots and animation 

  - clean topology, quads only, poles have maximum 5 edges 

  - carefully modelled to real world scale(centimeters) 

  - materials and textures have unique and meaningful names 

  - each model has proper unwrapped non-overlapping UVs (0-1 space).

Maya file has VRay Standard Materials (VRayMtl) assigned.
Two kinds of texture maps included: 

  - Textures ready for V-Ray(diffuse, specular, glosiness), also suitable for most offline render enginges;

  - PBR metalness workflow (basecolor, metallic, roughness), ready for Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR) and other real-time apps.

There is also a zip file containing all grinders as separated OBJs. 
If you need help setting up materials in other render engines feel free to contact me!

A set of dishes designed to quickly enhance realism in renders. It has 12 pieces: a large and a small bowl, two dishes, three tea plates, three different cups and two mugs. It's easy to use and lets you compose a realistic scene in matter of seconds. 
All the models are in real scale (units: centimeters). This is a HIGH POLY model, which means that it's designed for close-ups and will take some resources to render. It's not ideal for animations, VR and game engines – for that look for a LOW POLY version on my CGTrader page.

This is a dish set designed to quickly enhance your renders. It's ideal for interior, architecture and product renders. This set is easy to use and you can set a composition in matter of seconds. The set consists of two bowls, two dishes, three tea plates, three cups and two mugs. All models are in real scale (units: centimeters).
This is a LOW POLY model, which means that it has few polygons and doesn't need much resources for render. This type of models is ideal for VR, animations and game engines. It looks great from afar but if you want to make close-up renders, use a subdivision modifier or look for a high poly version on my CGTrader page. 
All the textures in the model are hand-painted, 4k PBR. Each object has a Diffuse, Roughness and Normal maps. All objects are UV unwrapped. Depending on your software, you may need to relink the textures. If you have any problems with shaders try to reduce the Normal map strength. 
The archive contains models in .blend, .obj and .fbx formats.
Poly count: bowls – 640, large dish – 608, small dish – 640, large and medium plates – 576, small plate – 544, cups – 770, mugs – 894.

description_text:
Hey all!
This was kinda like an extra model for decor in the king's room in Esther 6, but it never really got any screen time. I LOVED how it looked, so felt like I should add it here!This 16 piece set includes:

  - Large teapot/kettle

  - 6 saucers

  - 6 cups

  - 1 Sugar bowl

  - 1 Spoon

  - 1 Platter

Blend Features:

  - Principled BSDF shader for all materials

  - Curves maintained for cup ears, spot and handle

  - Procedural wood for the demo table

  - Image based engraving - baked procedural texture (bump)

  - Medium res to be used close-up (subdiv as needed) as well as in the background

  - Instanced and Eevee based for render speed - cycles compatible

  - All objects named properly and No modifiers

  - All pieces loose from platter for easy manipulation of either

DAE, FBX, OBJ, GLTF - All converted quite stably, only exceptions are the procedural wood (noise texture stretched), which is excluded cause procedural, and the normals are ALWAYS misunderstood, so for that material (Copper - Engraved), you have to define the bump map included in the zip as a UV coordinates bump map. For Blender, a strength of 0.220 was perfect in most instances. Aside from that, minor material adjustments and you're golden! All curves converted to Mesh.
STL - Pieces joined and exported to STL
Other formats: Formats are provided for convenience sake. Most export reliably, like the above descriptions, but keep in mind what these formats are used for and that they're non-native.
Some example uses:

  - Character conversations

  - Quiet contemplation

  - Scene decor for a more Eastern feel

  - Show-piece for an insert shot

  - Hotel Lobby

  - Kitchen counter

  - VIP tea time

  - Royalty at dinner

This tea set is a very warm color and does incredibly well in warmly lit environments. If you have a cooler environment, it'll ad a warm touch to the space. Think of a more white apartment or suite with this by the window or out on the patio! So beautiful!
Be sure to check out Esther 6, KJV if you haven't already!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bSaZxE6L96I
All preview images are from the Blend version - Native format

OverviewKitchen Suite 4 with Cabinets and Stools is a professional-grade, high-quality interior 3D model designed for contemporary residential visualizations, modern apartment layouts, luxury real estate staging, and architectural marketing projects (ArchViz). This comprehensive kitchen furniture scene features a sleek minimalist cabinet layout, an elegant island counter setup, ergonomic bar stools, and fully textured built-in kitchenware appliances.
The model is built with strict precision to a 1:1 real-world scale using millimeters (mm) as the native workspace units. It arrives completely centered at the origin of the coordinates system (0,0,0) for an efficient, instant drag-and-drop production workflow.
Key Features & Curated Content
  - 
Complete Built-In Scene: Includes high-quality kitchen units, overhead cabinets, a central kitchen island, bar stools, and modern light fixtures.

  - 
Integrated Appliances & Decor: Populated with an oven, cooking hob, sink mixer faucet, marble countertops, and decorative tableware props (wine glasses, plates, shelving decor) to provide instant visual depth.

  - 
Ready-to-Render Corona Materials: Originally authored and pre-shaded natively for Corona Render. Complex multi-materials, premium marble textures, realistic glass reflections, and synthetic wood shaders are fully configured and active out of the box.

  - 
No Third-Party Plugins Required: Open and operate the entire master file seamlessly without needing any active external geometry extensions or additional custom utility software.

Technical Specifications
  - 
Geometry: Clean polygonal mesh (Mid-Poly optimized interior asset)

  - 
Polygons: 256,970

  - 
Vertices: 261,551

  - 
UV Mapping: Expertly unwrapped coordinates handled manually to ensure accurate, tileable, and seamless texture projection with zero stretching or rendering artifacts.

  - 
Stripped Map Layout: All required texture asset file paths are completely stripped for a clean, error-free pathing experience upon initial scene loading.

File Formats Included
  - 
3ds Max 2018 (Native master format with complete, configured Corona materials and shaders)

  - 
FBX (Autodesk binary format — compact, fast loading, and highly compatible — 13.1 MB)

  - 
OBJ (High-quality geometry exchange file with active layout channels — 31.2 MB)

  - 
Texture Package (Complete high-quality diffuse and surface texture maps archive included)

*Important Compatibility Notice for BuyersThis indoor kitchen asset was natively authored in 3ds Max using Corona Render shaders. Visual previews demonstrate the exact output achieved with this setup. When importing universal exchange formats like OBJ or FBX into alternative 3D applications (such as Blender, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, or Maya), the file will reliably preserve the high-quality geometry and manual non-overlapping UV layouts; however, complex material configurations, custom glass reflections, and specific metal shaders may require manual reconstruction depending on your target rendering engine. Standard OBJ packages do not standardly include a separate .mtl file, but you may contact me directly to request one, and it will be prepared for you immediately.

description_text:
The immediacy of the Single Basket Lamp draws anyone's attention. Its essential form was developed by Stephen in a small basket weaving community outside of Thies, the second city of Senegal. Given the fact that all Senegalese sweetgrass baskets are uniquely woven in form, color and pattern from a collective memory passed down for generations, Stephen was the first in this community to teach the weavers to work from a drawing. The resulting iconic pendant lamp is available with and without a diffuser to showcase it's simple, yet beautiful pattern language and technique inside and out. Prototyped and developed as part of the Studio Museum exhibition, Stephen Burks Man Made, 2011.
This model is Stephen Burks Man Made studio approved and is a precise replica of the real item.
Polygon model of Single Basket Lampof Stephen Burks Man Made Senegalese Collection. Ready for close-up rendering, uses V-Ray materials.

description_text:
The Tefifon is a German-developed and manufactured audio playback format that utilizes cartridges loaded with an endlessly looped reel of plastic tape (much like the later 4-track and 8-track magnetic audio tape cartridges) with grooves embossed on it, similar to the ones on a phonograph record. The grooves were embossed in a helical fashion across the width of the tape, much similar to Dictaphone's Dictabelt format, and are read with a stylus and amplified pickup in the player's transport. A Tefifon cartridge can hold up to four hours of music; therefore, most releases for the format are usually compilations of popular hits or dance music, operas and operettas. Tefifon players were not sold by television and radio dealers in Germany, but rather sold directly by special sales outlets affiliated with Tefi (the manufacturer of the format)

description_text:
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.
Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing. We take care to build the smallest detail in the model to ensure the best results. These things are not in others.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

- No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.Thanks you for attention. Hope you can find proffesional model for your works.

Brief Teapot History: The teapot was invented in China during the Yuan Dynasty. It was probably derived from ceramic kettles and wine pots, which were made of bronze and other metals and were a feature of Chinese life for thousands of years. ... In the Tang Dynasty, a cauldron was used to boil ground tea, which was served in bowls. The world owes tea to the Chinese, but the design of the teapot to the Europeans. The first ceramic teapots were heavy with short straight replaceable spouts. description_text:
A classic twin bell alarm clock with a lot of details. This clock was modeled with Blender 2.73 and rendered in Cycles.
YOU WANT A LOW POLY GAME READY VERSION OF THIS MODEL? JUST LET ME KNOW!
|| GEOMETRY ||
Clean geometry, only quads. No ngons! For full and easy geometry control all parts are separated and all used modifiers are not applied.
Used modifiers:
  - subsurf - mirror - solidify
|| TEXTURES ||
This model uses a image texture (jpg) at 1700 x 1700 pixels for the clock face and a second one at 2048 x 2048 pixels as bump map for the back side of the clock.
|| MATERIALS ||
6 materials created with nodes for Cycles Render.
  - chrome - black - black paint - black paint with bump - clock face - glass
|| COMPOSITING ||
Compositing setup to render the model isolated from the environment with alpha values as background included.
|| RENDERS ||
  - renders created in Cycles Render at 1.000 samples using subsurf modifier level 2 - wireframe renders are showing the mesh without subsurf modifier
|| SCALE ||
The model is in real world size and scale.
X = 0,126m (Blender units) Y = 0,104m (Blender units) Z = 0,166m (Blender units)
|| EXPORTED FILES ||
This model was created with Blender. Only the blend file includes materials, textures and modifiers. All other formats have been exported and including only the mesh!
|| END ||

description_text:
Technivorm Moccamaster KBG 741 coffee machine 3D model.
MODELMoccamaster model is made from 14 polygonal and 1 spline objects. All objects are grouped into 3 groups for easy scene handling.Most objects are modelled as subdivisional and have turbosmooth modifier applied. Turbosmooth modifier is instanced on all objects, which allows easy to change between subdivision levels.Model comes in 11 distinct colour variations. Additional colours are available in 3ds Max for Corona and Vray files only.Coffee bubbles are scattered with CoronaScatter plugin and are available in 3ds Max for Corona file only.Electrical cord is made of renderable spline and can be easily reshaped according to your needs.Model is made of quads and triangles. No N-gons were used. 95% of polygons, are quads.Polycount:Subdivision level - 0Polys - 25 629Verts - 19 273Subdivision level - 2Polys - 327 625Verts - 167 423
MATERIALSMaterials are prepared for Corona, Vray and Scanline renderers.Scanline scene has only basic materials and will NOT render the same as in preview images.FBX file has greatly simplified materials and may require significant rework after import.OBJ file has very basic materials or no materials at all.
TEXTURESModel has 2 high quality texture of up to 1600 x 1600 resolution.Textures are saved in losseless PNG format.Textures are collected in one archive and are delivered in separate file.
SCENEModel is scaled to proper real world dimensions. Scene units are in cm.All objects, materials and textures are properly and uniquely named.All transformations has been reset and model is placed at scene origin [0, 0, 0 XYZ].All texture paths are set to relative.
FILE FORMATS3ds Max - Corona3ds Max - Scanline3ds Max - VrayFBXOBJ - subdividedOBJ - not subdivided
GENERALModeled in 3ds max.Preview images are rendered with Corona renderer. Images are straight from 3ds Max. No post processing appart from Corona renderer built in tonemapping tools, were applied.Render scenes are not included.
Please contact me if you have questions or need assistance with the models.

description_text:
About this:
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray. Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

- No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.About bee3dd team:

  - Top skill with hard-surface modeling

  - Can use over 10 softwaves to make 3d models

  - Offer: 3d models of electronic - car - product design - architect ( you can find a lot of model in our store )Every model we build goes through thorough Quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality.

description_text:
Game ready refrigerator PBR game engines/renderers.
The door can be opened and closed.
This product is intended for game/real time/background use. This model is not intended for subdivision. Renders done in Marmoset Toolbag 3. Default renders in 3ds Max will NOT look like the preview images. The Marmoset Toolbag scene IS included.
SPECS

  - Geometry is in quads and tris, no n-gons.

  - Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space.

  - All materials and objects named appropriately

  - Scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters)

  - Tested in Marmoset Toolbag 3 (see renders)

  - Tested in Unreal Engine 4

  - Tested in Unity Engine

  - No special plugins needed.

  - .obj and .fbx versions exported from 3ds Max 2019

Textures

  - 2048x2048 base color, roughness, metalness, normal and AO (ambient occlusion)

  - Also included: textures in specular/gloss PBR format for those who prefer that setup.

  - Textures designed for physically based rendering (PBR)

  - Model texture paths are stripped

I have exported specialized texture maps for Unreal Engine 4 and Unity. See the extra downloads section for those textures and instructions on using them. Substance Painter source files also available in the extra downloads so that you can easily alter the textures as you wish with Substance Painter.

description_text:
Hi I am Frezzy from Vnvisual studio.
This model is high quality, photo real model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects.The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.Fidelity is optimal up to a 4k render. Renders have no postprocessing.
This model is ready to be animated. You can easily position it the way you need or animate.
+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All colors can be easily modified.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 V-Ray ( 2.4 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2012 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2012 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2012 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2012 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R12 with standard materials

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures )
  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).
+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

+++++++++++++++About Vnvisual:We are a team of 3D artists with over a decade of experience in the field. My team participated in various projects allowing us to learn our clients needs.Every model we build goes through thorough quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality, which you can tell by looking at the renders none of the has any postprocessing.On the top of that all the models come with complete UVs and optimized topology, which allows you in no time alter geo or the textures if needed.
  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

High-quality, photorealistic 3D model of a Modern Wooden Kitchen Set, featuring contemporary minimalist cabinets and premium marble countertops. This high-end interior furniture scene comes fully loaded with a detailed tableware setup, storage shelves, realistic wine bottles with wineglass props, a modern hob, integrated kitchenware mixer, and built-in oven equipment.
Production-ready and meticulously crafted for professional interior architectural visualization (ArchViz), luxury apartment kitchen renders, modern residential house designs, open-space studio layouts, and digital home staging projects.

  - UV Mapping: Professionally unwrapped UVs, 100% manual layout with non-overlapping islands.

  - Textures & Materials: High-resolution wood grain, marble stone, glass, and metal PBR texture maps included. Fully configured with native high-fidelity Corona Render shaders.

  - Format Compatibility: 3ds Max 2018 and backwards compatible 3ds Max 2015 file setups included.

  - Universal Exchange Formats: OBJ (2 files), FBX (Autodesk FBX), and 3DS (3D Studio) included with completely stripped texture paths.

  - Clean Asset: No external third-party scripts or plugins required to open and render the scene.

Hope you like it! Also check out my other models, just click on my username to see the complete gallery. If satisfied with the model, please leave positive feedback! Thank you!

description_text:
Real-Time,Game Ready, Retro Wooden Crate.
Dimensions: 1mx1m
Display images were rendered in Marmoset Toolbag.
Normal maps were baked from a high poly model in Substance Painter. The Normal Maps are baked with the MikkT tangent space setting.
Includes the following 3d file types: (use the .fbx file to import into any popular 3d package)
Blender 2.90.1.FBX.OBJMarmoset 2 File - (the images you see in the thumbnails are using this file)
The textures are located in the .zip file. You will also find all the program files located in the .zip folder. We recommend downloading the .zip and opening up your desired 3d format from there, the texture paths should automatically hook up that way.
Includes the following PBR texture types (BOTH Metalness and Specular workflows, perfect for Unity, Cryengine and UE4):
4096x4096: Ambient_Occlusion 4096x4096: Normal Map
4096x4096: Diffuse 4096x4096: Gloss 4096x4096: Specular
4096x4096: Base Color 4096x4096: Roughness 4096x4096: Metalness
Source texture maps from the hi-poly bake are also included so you can re-texture if desired.
4096x4096: Ambient_Occlusion 4096x4096: Curvature 4096x4096: MeshNormals 4096x4096: Position 4096x4096: Thickness 4096x4096: World_Space_Normal
Note about textures. The Normal maps are -y, this is fine for directx. If they look flipped, just highlight the green channel in photoshop and hit ctrl+i.
If the roughness and metalness look too shiny in say, UE4, you'll have to make sure they are set to linear. Just double click the texture and uncheck the sRGB box. You can also fix that by combining maps in an image editor like Photoshop.
UV's are mostly flat with a few pieces overlapping where necessary.
Units are Metric.
Game Ready!
Please click on my Username for more Game-Ready models!

The Great One by Luxo | 3d model produced by Design Connected | www.designconnected.com
This 3d model is part of the highly acclaimed Design Connected collection featuring 6500+ carefully picked exclusive furnishings. Check out our full range of 3d models for more mid-century icons, contemporary classics and designer masterpieces.
All Design Connected 3d models are originally created in 3ds Max and V-Ray renderer.
Our in-house team of 3d artists handle all further remodelling, materials conversions and other adaptations to deliver best possible visual and technical quality of all the additional file formats and renderers we offer. 
Files units are centimeters and all models are accurately scaled to represent real-life object's dimensions.
Our models come as a single editable mesh or poly object (or as group for rigged models or where displace modifier has been used) properly named and positioned in the center of coordinate system. No lights, cameras and render/scene setup are included unless otherwise stated in the particular model’s description.
AVAILABLE FILE FORMATS

  - Sketchup  8 or above

  - OBJ and FBX

ADDITIONAL FILE FORMATS UPON REQUEST

  - ARCHICAD R16 or above

  - Autodesk 3ds

  - Maya 

  - Lightwave 

  - Collada 

PRODUCT DESCRIPTIONBrand: Luxo, Norwayhttp://www.luxo.comDesigner: Jac JacobsenDesign Connected ID: 2232
BEFORE PURCHASEWe highly recommend that you download few of our FREE 3D MODELS and test if they work well with your 3d software before making a purchase.

  - 
3 Versions for every file format: Beveled - suitable for subdivision and/or smooth shading, Unbeveled - intended as a background object, unsuitable for subdiv/ smooth shading but with a smaller amount of vertices, Subdivided - subdivided in advance;

  - Tailored textures with multiple resolutions (like 2K, 4K) for a PBR Metalness workflow, such as DIFFUSE/METALLIC/ROUGHNESS/NORMAL;

  - All model versions also have UV unwrapping and appropriate pivot/origin points;
