Gubi Suspension Satellite 3D model by CG Factory.
Archive contains 2 different model sizes (Large and Medium) and 3 finishes.
Dimensions:Large: Height: 38.4 cm; top hat size: 57 x 36 cm; Lantern diameter: Ø27.2 cm.Medium: Height: 31.5 cm; top hat size: 45 x 27 cm; Lantern diameter: Ø21.8 cm.
Archive contains: 3ds max file with V-Ray materials; 3ds max file with Corona materials; Obj. fail; FBX. fail; Textures;
Description from manufacturer:The Satellite Collection Gubi of two pendant lamps with geometrical shapes and an organic shade is designed by Mathieu Matégot in 1953 to create outstanding sculptural aesthetics. The name, Satelitte, was given by Matégot as a wink and tribute to the scientific progress in France in the years after the Second World War. The Satellite Collection holds the distinctive trait of Rigitulle, a technique and material invented by the designer himself that makes it possible to bend and fold the fabric like metal sheet to an original, oblong shaped pendant lamp. The lampshade has five colour options and is unique with its bulb all covered by perforated metal to exude an atmospheric light – creating a festive appearance. The interplay of light and shadow casted on walls and floors generate a dramatic feature in any dining room, hallway or restaurant. Hang the satellite Pendant Lamp alone as a characteristic piece or in multiples to create a cloud of luminosity.

  - Textures in .png format 

  - Model texture paths are stripped

I have exported specialized texture maps for Unreal Engine 4 and Unity. See the extra downloads section for those textures and instructions on using them. Substance Painter source files also available in the extra downloads so that you can easily alter the textures as you wish with Substance Painter.

Hello, I am Frezzy from beeditor.com.

The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.
Fidelity is optimal up to a 4K render. Renders have no postprocessing.
--INFO ABOUT 3D MODELS:
Features:
- High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.
- Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)
- All colors can be easily modified.
- Model is fully textured with all materials applied.
- All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.
- 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.
- No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.
- No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.
- No special plugin needed to open scene.
- Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

File Formats:
- 3ds Max 2012 V-Ray ( 2.4 ) and standard materials scenes
- OBJ (Multi Format)
- 3DS (Multi Format)
- Maya 2012
- Cinema 4D R12
- FBX (Multi Format)
All Files was archived with winrar 5.4. If you get error when extract, please use the latest version fo winrar. ( winrar is free for all )

Textures: ( just for the models have textures )
- High resolution ( ready for 4K rendering ) and named, easy to find and editing.
- Photoshop File ( Photoshop CC2017 was included for editing textures like you want )

Also check out my other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

This is premium 3D model from CGcarrot Studio. We greatly appreciate you choosing our 3D models and hope they will be of use.We look forward to continuously dealing with you.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - OBJ 2012 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2012 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2012 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2012 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R12 with standard materials

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

Textures: ( just for the models have textures )

description_text:
This set includes four different Stainless Steel Cooking Pots with Glass Covers. Created with Blender 2.76 and rendered in Cycles.
|| GEOMETRY ||
Clean geometry, quads only. No ngons! Modifiers are not applied, so you still have full and easy geometry control.
Used modifiers:
  - subsurf - mirror - solidify
|| VERTEX COUNT ||
One pot has 5.876 Vertices and 5.900 Faces. All four pots have 23.504 Vertices and 23.600 Faces.
|| MATERIALS ||
3 Materials created with nodes for Cycles Render. Colors are changeable in the node setup.
  - chrome - stainless steel - glass
|| COMPOSITING ||
Compositing setup to render the model isolated from the environment with alpha values as background included.
|| RENDERS ||
  - renders created in Cycles Render at 10.000 samples using subsurf modifier level 2 - wireframe renders are showing the mesh without subsurf modifier
|| SCALE ||
The model is in real world size and scale.
Small Pot:
X = 0,252m (Blender units) Y = 0,176m (Blender units) Z = 0,169m (Blender units)
Medium Pot:
X = 0,293m (Blender units) Y = 0,217m (Blender units) Z = 0,189m (Blender units)
Flat Pot:

Big Pot:
X = 0,338m (Blender units) Y = 0,262m (Blender units) Z = 0,209m (Blender units)
|| EXPORTED FILES ||
This model was created with Blender. Only the blend file includes materials and modifiers. All other formats have been exported and are including only the mesh!

A set of fireplace tools. Set consists of 5 items: stand, poker, spade, broom and tongs. Tools made of painted cast iron, handles made of brass.
Modeled in 3ds max.Model is scaled to proper real world dimensions. Scene units are in cm.All objects, materials and textures are properly and uniquely named.All transformations are reset and model is placed at scene origin.All texture paths are set to relative.Materials are prepared for Corona and Scanline renderers. If you have questions about my models or need any kind of help, feel free to contact me and i'll do my best to help you.

description_text: This is an electric fondue maker from Russell Hobbs, it's no advertising, just wanted to put some logo on it to make it more interesting :) It is not a simple copy of an existing device but a modification of a one. Important:You can download a lot of files, like 3ds Max 2017 archivated scene with ALL materials and settings, so you dont need to do anything, its ready for you scene. When you open the last folder of this archive, you will find all maps and textures for, used for the model. You can also download 3ds Max 2017 and 2019 files (all Max files contain the whole scene) and OBJ, FBX, STL and MTL files of the model (fondue set is separate from walls and floor in these file formats). I have also added a rps file with V ray settings for you maybe to use it as a preset. FBX model has no materials but if you open it in 3ds Max you still can make a render with materials and Pick Material Tool also works. I dont work with FBX file formats so i dont know a lot about how the materials there work, but i think, you know how to do everything with that. I did my best with this model, it has no trash, the grid is very good everywere. I have also added a small 3 minutes guide for you to know how the material of the logo is made (it`s Vray blend MTL with base - steel material) and which problems you can gave with it and how you can solve them. It is not a big deal, but to be sure that you will have no problems with the model. So, i hope i will enjoy my work. Thank you for your attantion. Contact me, if you need something.

High quality grid, 3k wood texture, texture coordinates setted with Unwrapped UVW modificator. description_text:
The file is created in Cinema 4D S24.111.Main archive includes files with extensions .c4d, .max, .obj, .3ds, .fbx(2018) etc. But you can download necessary file formats separately. Also archive includes a game engine folders. Folder unity contains unitypackage format(Unity 2020.3).Folder unreal_engine contains files and folders Unreal Engine 4.27 or 5.0 format.Textures in 4K resolution. 
Polygons: 880Triangles: 1744Vertices: 962
Using:
3DS Max 2022

  - If you using 3ds max 2022, unzip archive 3ds_max.zip, then open file by double-clicking the left mouse button on sledgehammer.max.

  - For use in other scene, use the command: File -> Merge.

Cinema 4D S24
  - If you using Cinema 4D S24, unzip archive 3ds_max.zip, then open file by double-clicking the left mouse button on sledgehammer.c4d.
Other 3d modeling packages:
  - Use command: File - Import and choose sledgehammer.obj or sledeghammer.3ds, or sledgehammer.fbx files.
Unity 2020.3
  - Use command: Assets -> Import Package -> Custom Package... and choose sledgehammer_hdrp.unitypackage or sledgehammer.unitypackage file. It contains in archive unity.zip. Search .unitypackage files in folders HDRP or Universal, dependings what pipeline you use.
Unreal Engine 4.27 or 5.0
  - Unzip unreal_engine.zip archive. Open ue_4_27 or ue_5 folder and copy/paste folder sledgehammer in your unreal engine project directory. For other purposes this folders contains textures and fbx file.Make shure that current project is closed in unreal engine before you copy/paste sledgehammer folder. You need copy it in project_name folder->Content

Studio by Muuto | 3d model produced by Design Connected | www.designconnected.com
This 3d model is part of the highly acclaimed Design Connected collection featuring 6500+ carefully picked exclusive furnishings. Check out our full range of 3d models for more mid-century icons, contemporary classics and designer masterpieces.
All Design Connected 3d models are originally created in 3ds Max and V-Ray renderer.
Our in-house team of 3d artists handle all further remodelling, materials conversions and other adaptations to deliver best possible visual and technical quality of all the additional file formats and renderers we offer. 
Files units are centimeters and all models are accurately scaled to represent real-life object's dimensions.
Our models come as a single editable mesh or poly object (or as group for rigged models or where displace modifier has been used) properly named and positioned in the center of coordinate system. No lights, cameras and render/scene setup are included unless otherwise stated in the particular model’s description.
AVAILABLE FILE FORMATS

  - Sketchup  8 or above

  - OBJ and FBX 

  - Abvent Artlantis 

  - Cinema4D  R16 or above-- Adv. / Physical-- V-Ray 1.9-- V-Ray 3.4

ADDITIONAL FILE FORMATS UPON REQUEST

  - ARCHICAD R16 or above

  - Autodesk 3ds 

  - Rhinoceros 

  - Autodesk DWG 

  - Maya 

  - Lightwave 

  - Collada 

PRODUCT DESCRIPTIONBrand: Muuto Denmark http://muuto.comDesigner: Thomas BernstrandDesign Connected ID: 5382
BEFORE PURCHASEWe highly recommend that you download few of our FREE 3D MODELS and test if they work well with your 3d software before making a purchase.
ABOUT THE IMAGERYPreviews rendered in 3dsMax using VRay. Please note that the studio scenes and light and environment settings are not included.
SUPPORTIf you have any questions about how to use Design Connected 3d models, please contact us via Support.
Thank you for purchasing Design Connected models!

description_text:
UPD for those who acquired this asset before - new 8K texture set added and fibers/fuzz mesh. Also, the mesh is now provided with thickness/shell, not just one-sided.
  - General
This is a 3D model of a burlap bag kitchen sack. It was modeled and prepared for photorealistic renderings, close-ups, stills, and animation. The burlap bag model is ready to be inserted into your scene out of the box.
  - Meshes
The burlap bag models are presented as single meshes in 3 versions. Meshes are quad-based. The polycounts are roughly the same for all 3 ~10K quads. Each of the bags is provided with fuzz/fibers mesh to enhance the visuals - the fibers all have the same polycount of 259K. The bag models are included in .max, .fbx, and .obj formats. The original mesh is a one-sided type of geometry, but .fbx and .obj are provided both as one-sided and with shell/thickness variations. .max format has a non-collapsed modifier stack with Shell and TurboSmooth for your convenience.
  - Materials
.max 2020 files come with Chaos Corona Renderer 9 shaders. Other versions have basic materials, so you must adjust them with your particular software/render engine.
  - Textures
7 maps are supplied with this model. Textures supplied are in JPG format and are in 2K, 4K, and 8K resolution. The texture maps include ao, diffuse, glossiness, roughness, normal, opacity, and displacement(png). The burlap bag models are uvw unwrapped. 
  - Formats
The original file was prepared in 3ds Max 2023 with Corona 9 materials. You will receive OBJ, FBX, and MAX files(2020). 
  - Information
All preview images were rendered with Corona Renderer. You will get only the burlap bag, not the scenes used for preview renders. Please also consider that the preview images are the result of the post-production and the look of the burlap bag 3D model in your scene may differ due to the specific settings of your 3D setup. The product is ready to render out-of-the-box. Please note that the lights, cameras, and any background not described above objects are not included in the product. The model is clean and alone in the provided files, centered at the origin, and has a real-world scale.

  - 1 health pack

  - 1 energy cell

  - 4 bio containers

  - 2 pill boxes

  - 4 pills

  - PSDs with intact layers are included

  - PBR textures (metallic)

  - Texture sizes are 4096 and 2048

  - Tris count between 240 - 1400

  -   Albedo map, PNG format

  -   Ambient Occlusion (AO) map, PNG format

  -   Normal map, PNG format

  -   Metalness map, PNG format

  -   Gloss map, PNG format

  -   Specular map, PNG format

  -   Roughness map, PNG format

Depending on your game engine/3D application you may need to rescale the models.

description_text:
3D model of Microwave Oven with Grill.
MODEL

  - Model dimensions: LWH 51,0 x 40,1 x 30,5 cm (20.1 x 15.8 x 12.0 in).

  - Objects count - 22

  - Subdivision - Partial (some objects in 3ds Max scene has instanced turbosmooth modifier applied).

  - Grouping - YES

  - Model is polygonal. Consists mainly of quads and triangles. Small amount of N-gons were used where appropriate.

  - Polycount:

  - Without subdivision -

  - Polys - 253 330

  - Verts - 289 024

  - With level 2 subdivision -

  - Polys - 330 565

  - Verts - 326 884

MATERIALS

  - Materials are prepared for Corona and V-ray renderers.

  - Scanline and FBX files has only basic materials and will NOT render the same as in preview images.

  - OBJ file has no materials, but has UVW coordinates intact.

TEXTURES

  - Model has 6 high quality textures of up to 1024 x 1024 resolution.

  - Textures are saved in JPEG and PNG formats.

  - Textures are collected in one archive and are delivered in separate file.

SCENE

  - Model is scaled to proper real world dimensions. Scene units are in cm.

  - Objects, materials and textures has meaningful and matching names.

  - Transformations has been reset and model is placed at scene origin [0, 0, 0 XYZ].

  - Texture paths are set to relative. Just unzip texture archive into a folder where the model is located and your 3D app should pick up them automatically.

RIG

  - Microwave oven's door are rigged with convenient helper which allows easily and conveniently open and close the door. Door movement is restricted accordingly  to real world counterpart.

  - FBX file has simplyfied rig.

  - OBJ file is not rigged.

FILE FORMATS

  - 3ds Max - Corona

  - 3ds Max - Scanline

  - 3ds Max - Vray

  - FBX

  - OBJ

  - GLB

GENERAL

  - Modeled in 3ds max.

  - Preview images are rendered with Corona renderer. Images are straight from 3ds Max. No post processing appart from Corona renderer built in tonemapping tools, were applied.

  - Render scenes are not included.

Please contact me if you have questions or need assistance with the models.

description_text:
One of Malay traditional fishing methods that were used back in the days. The bubu is made of bamboo, with rattan rings as frames.  Bubu also can be called as 'traps' or 'guiding barrier'. It can be carried with hand or to shoulder depending on the size. It is designed to work without attendance.
This type of fishing normally known and used by the local fishermans who lived near the sea, or river which usually placed on shallow water. It also works in the pond. 
The way Bubu works is by placing the bait inside the body of bubu and letting the fish to take the bait on a one-way path only through the funnel. While the other side is the door of the bubu for collecting the trapped fishes.

description_text:
Eau de toilette spray Daisy Dream by Marc Jacobs.
Collection includes three different sized bottles: 30ml, 50ml and 100ml.
Bottle glass is modelled with thickness and liquid inside glass bottle is slightly overlapping glass mesh. That provides most physically acurate renderings in most modern render engines.
Each file contains all three bottle models.
Modeled in 3ds max.Model is scaled to proper real world dimensions. Scene units are in cm.All objects, materials and textures are properly and uniquely named.All transformations are reset and models are placed at scene origin.All texture paths are set to relative.Materials are prepared for Corona and Scanline renderers. File for Scanline renderer has very basic materials and will NOT render the same as in preview images.Preview images are rendered with Corona.Textures are collected in one arhive.Render scene is not included.
Scene has 1 high quality texture in 1400x1400 resolution.
File formats available: max - fbx - obj - stl
Files other than max, may not have all features available, due to format restrictions.Some of most common restrictions are:max scene with scanline renderer - contains simplified materialsfbx - contains simplified materialsobj - contains simplified materials, has no vertex coloursstl - has no materials, has no vertex colours, has no UV coordinates
NOTESIn order to maintain correct look of the model, it is important that your application would support rendering of refraction. Without refraction it might be very hard to recreate exact look as in preview images. Please keep this in mind, especially if you're intended to use the model in real time apps.
Please contact me if you have questions or need assistance with the models.

This pack contains a high quality, low-poly coffee machine model set that can be used in any realtime renderer that supports the physically based rendering pipeline. The bundle contains the machine (removable water tank + top, separated lid to insert coffee capsule), a coffee cup, a coaster and a capsule model. They all share one material.
The poly count indicated here refers to all models together.
Available formats: .OBJ, .FBX, .3DS
Texture maps: Base color, metallic, roughness, normal, opacity, ambient occlusion, 2 different emission maps (idle, on)Format: Lossless .PNG (8bits/channel)Resolution: 2K (crisp clear from close-up, decrease as needed)
The asset was created with 3DS Max, high-poly sculpted with ZBrush, textured with Substance Painter.
